title: The weekend forecast
instructions: Hafta sonu hava durumu farklı bölgeler için veriliyor. Bölge, gün ve sıcaklıkları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Here's the weather for the weekend.

script.speaker: host
script.text: On Saturday, it'll be sunny in the south, with temperatures of about twenty-six degrees.

script.speaker: host
script.text: In the north, it'll be cloudy and cooler, around eighteen degrees, with some rain in the evening.

script.speaker: host
script.text: On Sunday, the rain will move to the south, so take an umbrella if you live there.

script.speaker: host
script.text: The north will be dry on Sunday, but very windy near the coast.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Next week will be warmer everywhere.

questions.prompt: What will the weather be like in the south on Saturday?
questions.feedback: Cumartesi güneyde güneşli, yaklaşık yirmi altı derece.
questions.evidence: it'll be sunny in the south

questions.prompt: What is the temperature in the north on Saturday?
questions.feedback: Kuzeyde daha serin, yaklaşık on sekiz derece.

questions.prompt: When will it rain in the north?
questions.feedback: Kuzeyde cumartesi akşam (in the evening) biraz yağmur var. Pazar kuzey kuru.
questions.evidence: with some rain in the evening.

questions.prompt: Who needs an umbrella on Sunday?
questions.feedback: Pazar yağmur güneye geçiyor; orada yaşayanlar şemsiye almalı.
questions.evidence: On Sunday, the rain will move to the south, so take an umbrella if you live there.

questions.prompt: What will it be like near the north coast on Sunday?
questions.feedback: Kuzey pazar kuru ama kıyıda çok rüzgârlı.
questions.evidence: but very windy near the coast.
